title: Brain Drain
flavorText: The brightest minds left for better weather, and their ballots followed them out of the zone.
rulesText: For the rest of the game, every time you buy a 3-voter card, the player after you may move one of your non-majority voters to an adjacent zone.

title: Guest Editor
flavorText: The paper handed its front page to a stranger, and the stranger had firm opinions about your map.
rulesText: Choose an opponent. On their next turn, they may use all of your redistricting rights.

title: Standoff
flavorText: Nobody moved for six hours, and then everybody moved at once.
rulesText:
Move any 3 voters that are in this zone; they stay within it.
OR
Move any 3 voters out of this zone.

title: Ransom Note
flavorText: The demands were cut from newsprint, and the asking price per constituent was quietly negotiable.
rulesText: Take 4 of your voters off the board and hold them on this card. You may pay 1 resource to get one of them back.

title: Retraction
flavorText: Correction: every promise printed last week was attributed to the wrong person entirely.
rulesText: Starting with you and going around, each player may give one of their Policy cards to the player on their left. A player who does gains 6 resources of their choice.

title: Dynasty
flavorText: The family name polls better than any of the people currently carrying it.
rulesText: Draw 2 voter cards. Keep one and give the other to an opponent. Both cards are taken for free right now, with no payment.

title: Leaked Tapes
flavorText: Ninety minutes of recording, and the only clean part was the hum of the machine.
rulesText: For the rest of the game, every Dirty Trick card you buy costs 1 extra resource.

title: Backroom Deal
flavorText: Two chairs, one table, and a handshake nobody was ever meant to photograph.
rulesText: Choose 2 players. On their next turns, each may also use the other's unlocked Level 3 powers. If either of them has no unlocked Level 3 power, both may instead use any one Level 3 power of their choice.

title: Flood Relief
flavorText: The water rose overnight, and by morning whole neighborhoods had woken up somewhere else.
rulesText: Starting with you and going around, every player may immediately move 1 voter, majority or not, as if using redistricting rights. None of these voters may be moved into a volatile area.

title: Quarantine
flavorText: The cordon went up quietly, and so did the numbers on the far side of it.
rulesText: Every opponent evicts 1 of their own voters. If a player breaks a majority by doing so, every other player gains 1 resource of their choice.

title: Relief Fund
flavorText: The fund was announced before the emergency ended and audited long after everyone stopped asking.
rulesText: Pay 1 resource of each of the four types to the bank. Until you have paid all four, you cannot buy anything.

title: Tabloid Scandal
flavorText: The photograph was blurry, the headline was not, and the presses ran until morning.
rulesText: On your next turn, every voter card costs 1 extra resource of any type.

title: Anonymous Tip
flavorText: The envelope carried no name, which somehow made everyone want it more.
rulesText: Draw the top 3 Dirty Trick cards. Keep one without showing it and shuffle the other two back into the deck. Then you must auction the kept card, with bidding starting at 2 resources.

title: Turf War
flavorText: Two blocks changed hands before lunch and not one complaint was ever filed.
rulesText: Every player converts 2 voters belonging to the player on their left. Each player who does not break a majority by doing so gains 2 resources.

title: Tax Audit
flavorText: The letter arrived on the cheapest possible paper and cost you a great deal anyway.
rulesText: You receive no resources from your next Policy card.

title: Data Broker
flavorText: Somebody sold everyone's habits back to them, then let the room pick the delivery address.
rulesText: The next Dirty Trick card in the draw pile is given away for free. All players vote on who receives it. Nobody may vote for themselves, and a tie is voted again.

title: Echo Chamber
flavorText: Say a thing loudly enough in a small enough room and it comes back to you with interest.
rulesText: Choose an opponent. On your next turn, they receive the same resources you receive.

title: Hydra
flavorText: Every crackdown seemed to produce two more organizers than it managed to remove.
rulesText: For one round starting this turn, gain 1 voter every time an opponent moves one of your voters.

title: Disqualified
flavorText: The paperwork was filed one day late, and a district lost its name on a technicality.
rulesText: The next 3 players after you each choose one open voter card and discard it, gaining the resources shown on it. No new voter card opens until all 3 have been discarded.

title: Supply Shortage
flavorText: The warehouses emptied first, and the queues outside them filled in before dawn.
rulesText:
Starting from the player on your left and going around, each player must choose one:
Discard 1 of their own voters.
OR
Choose an opponent, who gains a free voter.
